observations.behavior: Adds jitter window and doubles the backoff cap, changing retry behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the maximum backoff window for warehouse queue polling; a failure now allows up to 60s jitter instead of 30s, potentially desynchronizing fleet retries.

observations.behavior: Changes retry delay formula: interval + jitter over a doubling window, not interval * 2^exponent.
observations.posthog_connection: Replaces the backoff calculation; the retry delay becomes the normal poll interval plus jitter over a window, rather than a scaled backoff. This could change the timing and ordering of warehouse polling after failures.

observations.behavior: Adds batch_index, team_id, schema_id, run_uuid to candidate selection; removes metadata.

observations.posthog_connection: Selects only narrow keys for warehouse claim candidates, removing metadata. This could reduce payload size and memory pressure during warehouse claim queries.
